proof_body:
by
  intro p q P y a t hq hP hy
  have hd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (P s) * y s) (Real.exp (P s) * q s) s := by
    intro s
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (P s) * y s)
        (Real.exp (P s) * p s * y s + Real.exp (P s) * (q s - p s * y s)) s :=
      (hP s).exp.mul (hy s)
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun s => (hP s).continuousAt
  have hc : Continuous fun s => Real.exp (P s) * q s := (Real.continuous_exp.comp hPc).mul hq
  have hint : (∫ s in a..t, Real.exp (P s) * q s) = Real.exp (P t) * y t - Real.exp (P a) * y a :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hd s) (hc.intervalIntegrable a t)
  rw [hint, add_sub_cancel, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (p q P y : ℝ → ℝ) (a t : ℝ), Continuous q → (∀ s, HasDerivAt P (p s) s) → (∀ s, HasDerivAt y (q s - p s * y s) s) → y t = Real.exp (-P t) * (Real.exp (P a) * y a + ∫ s in a..t, Real.exp (P s) * q s)
